data_quality.note: price-level fields must be > 0 (nonpositive counts malformed); mark/index klines carry forward and showed no zero sentinels on staged symbols

eligibility_rule: all 2688 buckets of the formation window exist on BOTH routes at identical open times and finite (fail-closed)
feature_definition: mean over trailing 2688 completed 15m buckets of m_b=markClose/indexClose-1 (markPriceKlines symbol= / indexPriceKlines pair=)

gate_sidecar.rule: gate OPEN iff D(T) = cross-sectional IQR of the 28d levels > median of strictly-prior stamp IQRs (expanding; requires >= 6 prior stamps; undecided stamps flat)

lag_convention: bucket usable iff open+15m <= T (bar-close class)
notes: rank 1 = lowest premium level = long side of the same inside book
gate sidecar is conditioning-state measurement only (no PnL)

staging_identity_check.note: m_b vs premiumIndexKlines close; Binance derives the premium kline from higher-frequency mark/index snapshots, so equality at close is not exact -- declared absolute band 1e-3 vs measured max ~4.2e-4 (probe sample); the check verifies route/grid coherence, not exact identity
